# PACS

![Illustration of PACS
framework.](reference/figures/README-PACS_illustration.svg)

Illustration of PACS framework.

## PACS (Probabilistic model for Accessible Chromatin data in Single Cell)

PACS is a toolkit for snATAC-seq data analysis.

The key functionalities of PACS include:

1.  Depth correction for snATAC-seq data.
2.  Statistical test for complex data design
3.  Supervised cell type annotation (with a reference dataset)
4.  Batch effect correction enabled by statistical test framework

## Installation

You can install the current version of PACS from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Zhen-Miao/PICsnATAC") ## dependent package 
devtools::install_github("Zhen-Miao/PACS")
```

This installation step should take `< 5 min` on a standard desktop
machine. R version `> 4.0.0` is recommended (older R version has not
been tested).

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to run PACS common workflow:

``` r

library(PACS)

p_vals <- pacs_test_sparse(
  covariate_meta.data = meta.data,
  formula_full = ~ factor(cell_type) + factor(batch),
  formula_null = ~ factor(batch),
  pic_matrix = data_mat,
  cap_rates = capturing_probability
)
```

## Vignette and Interactive Notebooks

An interactive tutorial website with vignettes can be found at

<https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/>

Although not recommended, you can also run the analysis using Goolge
Colab, with one example shown below:

Notebook 1: [Type 1 error and power evaluation in real data
.](https://github.com/Zhen-Miao/PACS/blob/main/vignettes/Notebook_1_Test_For_Sens_Spec_real_kidney_data.ipynb)

## Citation:

Miao, Z., Wang, J., Park, K. Kuang, D. and Kim, J. **Model-based
compound hypothesis testing for snATAC-seq data with PACS.** *bioRxiv*
(2023). <https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2023.07.30.551108v1>

## snATAC-seq toolkits

PACS is one of the snATAC-seq toolkits developed by the Kim lab. Other
toolkits include:

- [**PICsnATAC**](https://github.com/Zhen-Miao/PICsnATAC)

Miao, Z and Kim, J. **Uniform quantification of single-nucleus ATAC-seq
data with Paired- Insertion Counting (PIC) and a model-based insertion
rate estimator.** Nature Methods 2024

## Contact

For any questions regarding the package, please contact Zhen Miao
(<zhenmiao@pennmedicine.upenn.edu>) or Junhyong Kim
(<junhyong@sas.upenn.edu>).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`CCT_internal_horizontal()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/CCT_internal_horizontal.md)
  : Cauchy Combination Test accelerated
- [`FindMarkersPACS()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/FindMarkersPACS.md)
  : Differential test with PACS on Seurat object
- [`compare_models()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/compare_models.md)
  : Use gLRT to compare two models and obtain p values
- [`compute_infor_mat_tilda()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/compute_infor_mat_tilda.md)
  : compute_information matrix tilda
- [`estimate_label_default()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/estimate_label_default.md)
  : Estimate cell type label for new data
- [`estimate_label_no_cap_rate_all_pks()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/estimate_label_no_cap_rate_all_pks.md)
  : Estimate cell type label for new data using all peaks as input
- [`estimate_parameters()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/estimate_parameters.md)
  : Estimate parameters for the full model
- [`estimate_parameters_null()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/estimate_parameters_null.md)
  : Estimate parameters for the null model
- [`infor_mat()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/infor_mat.md)
  : Information matrix – original without Firth prior
- [`irls_iter()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/irls_iter.md)
  : Iteratively reweighted least squares function (main function)
- [`irls_iter_nt()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/irls_iter_nt.md)
  : Iteratively reweighted least squares function – newton methods
- [`irls_iter_nt_null()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/irls_iter_nt_null.md)
  : Iteratively reweighted least squares function for null – newton
  method for the null model
- [`irls_iter_null()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/irls_iter_null.md)
  : Iteratively reweighted least squares function (main function) for
  the null model
- [`loss_firth_from_wii()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/loss_firth_from_wii.md)
  : Compute loss function with Firth regularization from Wii matrix
- [`loss_fun()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/loss_fun.md)
  : Calculate Loss Function without Firth prior
- [`loss_fun_star()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/loss_fun_star.md)
  : Regularized log loss function
- [`loss_grad_pen()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/loss_grad_pen.md)
  : Gradient of penalized loss ( Invariant prior)
- [`loss_gradient()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/loss_gradient.md)
  : Gradient of loss function without Firth prior
- [`our_method_no_firth()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/our_method_no_firth.md)
  : Internal evaluation use only – PACS Without Firth
- [`pacs_test_cumu()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/pacs_test_cumu.md)
  : likelihood ratio test with PACS – cumulative logit
- [`pacs_test_logit()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/pacs_test_logit.md)
  : Profile likelihood ratio test with PACS
- [`pacs_test_sparse()`](https://zhen-miao.github.io/PACS/reference/pacs_test_sparse.md)
  : Profile likelihood ratio test with PACS
